definitionZh: 焦点 CSS 假类代表了一个已经获得焦点的元素(如窗体输入). 通常在用户点击或点击某个元素或用键盘的 Tab 键选择某个元素时触发.
sourceDefinition: The :focus CSS pseudo-class represents an element (such as a form input) that has received focus. It is generally triggered when the user clicks or taps on an element or selects it with the keyboard's Tab key.
